intro.title: A Coffeehouse Built on Hospitality
intro.paragraph1: Layali Al Noor — "the nights of light" — opened its doors in Jumeirah in 2019 with a single ambition: to give Dubai a coffeehouse that feels like the majlis of an old friend, dressed in the polish of a five-star address.
intro.paragraph2: Every cup is poured with the same generosity that has defined Arabian hospitality for centuries, set against brass lanterns, dark oak and the quiet shimmer of gold leaf.

experience.title: A Ritual, Not Just a Cup
experience.subtitle: From the first pour to the last ember of incense, every detail is composed to slow the evening down.
experience.feature1Description: Small-batch beans roasted weekly and brewed to order by baristas trained in both third-wave technique and traditional Arabic methods.
experience.feature2Description: Our gahwa is prepared and poured tableside from a traditional brass dallah, cardamom and saffron blooming with every cup.
experience.feature3Description: As dusk settles over Jumeirah, the café dims into candlelight and brass — the city's most elegant hour, held a little longer.
experience.feature4Description: A small, dedicated team that remembers your name, your seat and the way you take your coffee.

hero.title: The Story of Layali Al Noor
hero.subtitle: A coffeehouse born from a simple belief: that hospitality, done properly, is an art form.

story.title: Nights of Light, Since 2019
story.paragraph1: Layali Al Noor — literally "the nights of light" — began as a single question: could a coffeehouse in Dubai hold the warmth of a family majlis and the polish of a five-star lounge at once?
story.paragraph2: Our founders, third-generation Emirati hosts, grew up watching their grandmother prepare gahwa for every guest who crossed the threshold, regardless of the hour. That ritual — unhurried, generous, deeply personal — became the founding principle of Layali Al Noor.
story.paragraph3: Today, in a quiet courtyard off Al Wasl Road, that same ritual is offered to residents, travelers and dreamers alike, dressed in dark oak, brass lanterns and the soft glow of gold leaf.
story.paragraph4: We are, at heart, still that same majlis — simply open to more of Dubai, every evening of the year.

values.title: Our Values
values.value1Description: Hospitality without measure. Every guest is served as though they were the only one in the room.
values.value2Description: From bean selection to the final pour, we hold every detail to a standard worthy of the ritual.
values.value3Description: We honor tradition rather than reinvent it — modern in setting, faithful in spirit.
values.value4Description: A space designed to slow time, where conversation is unhurried and silence is welcome too.

philosophy.title: Coffee as an Act of Welcome
philosophy.paragraph: In Arabian culture, coffee has never simply been a drink — it is a gesture. To pour gahwa for a guest is to say: you are welcome here, take your time, stay as long as you'd like. Every cup that leaves our dallah carries that same intention, whether you visit us for a quiet morning or a candlelit evening among friends.
philosophy.quote: Hospitality is not a service we provide. It is a story we tell, one cup at a time.

gahwaRose.name: Rose Gahwa with Dates
gahwaRose.description: Light-roast Arabic coffee finished with a whisper of rosewater, served alongside stuffed Medjool dates.

qahwaOmani.name: Omani-Style Qahwa
qahwaOmani.description: A deeper roast in the Omani tradition, bold and lightly bitter, balanced with cardamom and clove.

gahwaSada.name: Gahwa Sada, Pure
gahwaSada.description: Unsweetened and unadorned — Arabic coffee at its most traditional, for the purist.

signatureEspresso.name: Layali Signature Espresso
signatureEspresso.description: Our house blend of Yemeni and Ethiopian beans, pulled to a bright, chocolate-forward shot.

goldDustCappuccino.name: Gold Dust Cappuccino
goldDustCappuccino.description: A classic cappuccino finished with a dusting of edible gold and cinnamon.

saffronLatte.name: Saffron Latte
saffronLatte.description: Steamed milk infused with saffron and a touch of honey, layered over a double espresso.

dateFlatWhite.name: Date & Cardamom Flat White
dateFlatWhite.description: Silky microfoam over espresso, sweetened naturally with date syrup and cardamom.

turkishCoffee.name: Turkish Coffee with Delight
turkishCoffee.description: Slow-simmered in a copper cezve, served with a piece of house-made rose Turkish delight.

kunafaPistachio.name: Kunafa with Pistachio
kunafaPistachio.description: Crisp shredded pastry, warm sweet cheese and clarified butter, finished with crushed pistachio.

ummAliRoyale.name: Umm Ali Royale
ummAliRoyale.description: Warm bread pudding baked with cream, nuts and golden raisins — an Emirati classic, elevated.

dateTahiniTart.name: Date & Tahini Tart
dateTahiniTart.description: A silky tahini custard over a date caramel base, in a buttery shortcrust shell.

saffronBasbousa.name: Saffron Basbousa
saffronBasbousa.description: Semolina cake soaked in saffron syrup, layered with almonds.

baklavaSelection.name: Baklava Selection
baklavaSelection.description: An assortment of pistachio, walnut and cashew baklava, hand-layered in-house.

emiratiChebab.name: Emirati Chebab with Honey
emiratiChebab.description: Traditional saffron pancakes, served warm with Emirati honey and clotted cream.

balaleetSaffron.name: Balaleet with Saffron
balaleetSaffron.description: Sweet vermicelli spiced with saffron and cardamom, topped with a folded omelette.

manakishTrio.name: Manakish Trio
manakishTrio.description: Three warm flatbreads — za'atar, cheese and spiced lamb — baked to order.

shakshukaLayali.name: Shakshuka Layali
shakshukaLayali.description: Slow-simmered tomatoes and peppers, baked eggs, served with charred sourdough.

datesLabnehBoard.name: Dates & Labneh Board
datesLabnehBoard.description: Creamy strained yoghurt, Medjool dates, local honey and toasted walnuts.

roseSaffronMocktail.name: Rose & Saffron Mocktail
roseSaffronMocktail.description: A fragrant blend of rose water, saffron syrup and citrus, served over ice.

hibiscusElixir.name: Hibiscus Iced Elixir
hibiscusElixir.description: Chilled hibiscus tea steeped with mint and a touch of ginger.

dateMilkshake.name: Date Milkshake Royale
dateMilkshake.description: A rich blend of Medjool dates, vanilla bean ice cream and cold milk.

cardamomChaiLatte.name: Cardamom Chai Latte
cardamomChaiLatte.description: House-spiced chai, steeped slow and layered with steamed milk.

goldenLemonade.name: Layali Golden Lemonade
goldenLemonade.description: Fresh lemonade infused with saffron and a hint of mint.

fatima.name: Fatima Al Mazrouei
fatima.quote: Layali Al Noor feels like being welcomed into someone's home — if that home happened to serve the best gahwa in the city. It's become our Friday ritual.

james.name: James Whitfield
james.quote: I've visited coffeehouses across the world, and few have matched the warmth and precision here. The saffron latte alone is worth the trip back to Dubai.

noora.name: Noora Al Suwaidi
noora.quote: This is Emirati hospitality distilled into a single evening. The dallah service is a beautiful thing to witness, let alone taste.

marco.name: Marco Rossi
marco.quote: The attention to detail — lighting, pacing, the ceramics — rivals the finest lounges I've consulted for. A masterclass in atmosphere.

aisha.name: Aisha Rahman
aisha.quote: My go-to spot for client meetings that need to feel a little more special. Quiet, elegant, and the kunafa is unforgettable.

sophie.name: Sophie Laurent
sophie.quote: We wandered in on our last night in Dubai and stayed for three hours. Exactly the memory we wanted to take home.
